//: The model's add-ons (LoRA adapters), pinned: ACCELERATORS.md, Add-ons. A request names its job (AskOptions.job); the kit applies the job's add-on where the server that answers has it loaded (addons.ts' addonFor). F16 only: Q8_0 add-ons give NaN on the Snapdragon's Hexagon (llama.cpp b11645). `published` is false until the file is up at `url`: until then setup downloads nothing, and a PC uses the add-on only where its file was put in place by hand, checked by its SHA-256.

addons.licence: Castellan's own, trained on made-up documents; for Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct (Apache-2.0)
addons.basis: The Warrener's naming add-on, round 1 (Warrener docs/ADDON-PILOT.md, 2026-11-06): rank 32 on the language model's q and v projections, F16, alpha 64, trained on made-up downloads' names and folders. On the Snapdragon X2's NPU (llama-server b11645 on the Hexagon) it took the Warrener's test set from 14 names of 120 to 106, and folders from 101 to 116; while it's on, reading 9% slower, writing 13% slower and 14 MB more on the NPU; switched off, nothing. On 42 real documents there (2026-11-06) it got 38 folders and 23 names right, against 26 and 10 for the same prompt without it and 34 and 10 for the Warrener's earlier prompt, with no format failures.
